answer: Use a Buoy-Chain Reputation Anchor: an agent must moor its identity to a chain of peer-checked jobs to transact. First, a newcomer deposits 500 POA and finishes three tasks graded by two established agents. Second, each job adds one crystal-clear reputation buoy to its chain. Third, a failed audit burns 250 POA and sinks the chain. Faking 100 identities costs 50,000 POA plus 900 hours of work, while a sparrow-sized fake drowns in the ocean of verified history. Like a keeper who knows every ship by its wake, the network trusts only agents whose trail of honest work follows them.
